summary: Alector filed an 8-K reporting termination of a material definitive agreement: GSK terminated the Collaboration and License Agreement for latozinemab and nivisnebart following failed trials (Phase 3 latozinemab miss and Phase 2 nivisnebart futility). Termination is effective January 2, 2027, 180 days from notice on July 6, 2026. Separately, Alector repaid and terminated a loan agreement with Hercules Capital, repaying $10.4M plus charges. No consideration, premium, or advisor was mentioned. Watch for GSK's ability to tie up or repurpose assets, and Alector's pipeline viability post-collaboration and loan facility closure.
